title: P4 native Excel desktop acceptance
scope: One receipt-bound private Freddie-sample P4 portfolio workbook; opened read-only, macros and link updates disabled, recalculated in Excel, and not saved.

checks: ScenarioModel total equals the Summary total and saved research result within $0.000001.
Source amount reconciles to the Audit control; rounded amount difference is zero.
Adverse scenario selection remains explicit; source research EL remains Unavailable.
SourceScope receipt, metadata, and four import-output hashes match the local verified import.
39/39 relative upstream lineage path/hash pairs match metadata and the referenced local files.
SourceScope records ownership_certified=No, reported amount is EAD=No, visibility=private, public_release_approved=No.

decision_boundary: This verifies one P4 Excel export and does not qualify every workbook or route in CreditAtlas.
It does not authenticate Freddie publisher provenance, terms, redistribution rights, portfolio ownership, PD/LGD calibration, or ECL accounting use.
